claims_sample.text: All the results suggest that BPBDO is a 1-component photoinitiator that is an efficient photoinitiator for free radical polymerization.

Photopolymerization has received increased attention over the last few decades due to its several benefits, such as having high efficiency and low energy consumption and being environmentally friendly.1-5 It is a well-accepted technology that has attracted more interest from researchers for applications in various areas, eg, coatings, fast-drying varnishes, paints, printing inks, adhesives, optical waveguides, dental material, and microelectronics.6-8 Because of the wide use of monomers and photoinitiators (PIs), greater effort has been dedicated to free radical photoinitiated systems than the

abstraction or electron transfer reactions.1,2 Alcohols, amines, thiols, and ethers are used as coinitiators because of their hydrogen donating capability.1-3 Benzophenone is 1 of the most widely commercialized PIs1,3,4 because of its lower price, good surface curing property, oxygen inhibition effect,6,7 suitable solubility properties, and high quantum efficiency of the hydrogen abstraction.15 Also, the polymerization of (meth) acrylates is typically initiated by the radicals produced from the hydrogen donor in a BP photoinitiating system.
